title: Canonical roster metadata requires no Plant-create handoff

given.plant: a new active Plant whose creation transaction has committed
given.roster: canonical roster version 1 with exactly eight ordered agents

when.action: Plant creation completes and the application later starts

then.activation: all eight canonical agents become eligible for future typed invocation without an immediate model call
then.metadata: the same Plant and roster version derive the same eight introduction ids and exact presentation content
then.materialization_owner: only a later authorized active-Plant Feed open may ask FT-008 to insert missing presentation rows
then.forbidden: no batch, sink, result matrix, provider call, MessageEnvelope, Agent Chat Bus copy, agent-context copy, or change to Plant commit and 201 semantics
